name: The Sloop Inn
stayType: Harbourside inn with rooms and cottages
accommodation: Doubles, twins, suites, family rooms and cottages, many with harbour or sea views
suitableFor: Couples, families and friends wanting to stay in the centre of town
beachAccess: On the harbour front at The Wharf; Porthmeor is across the town
confirmedFeatures: Pub food, restaurant, breakfast, bar, webcams including Porthmeor
overview: A historic inn on the harbour front at The Wharf in St Ives, with rooms ranging from doubles and twins to suites, family rooms and cottages. Many rooms look over the harbour or the sea. The inn serves food from breakfast onwards, and Porthmeor Beach is a short walk across the old town.
surfTripFit: You stay in the centre of St Ives, a short walk through the old town to Porthmeor, and the inn runs a Porthmeor webcam.
